1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 395/2022 of PS Madhu Vihar for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.
The quashing is sought on the ground of compromise between the petitioners and the complainant de facto (respondent no.2).

3. Learned APP for State and learned counsel for respondent no.2 accept notice.
4.
